how_to_read: sentences[].w = first..last word id inside this chapter; word k (0-based) of the sentence is first+k and `ar` is the spoken text (its space-separated tokens are those words); fr = [start_frame, end_frame] at 24 fps from the word map; impact = hook words (id=text); num = spoken numbers with data-contract fact ids; first_mention = glossary terms to chip (id=term); dup = same claim in another chapter. Anchor with {word, lead_frames} only. Visual candidates are ideas, never footage.

constraints.anchors: {word, lead_frames} only; never seconds or frames; event frame = word start - lead_frames
constraints.lead_frames: kinetic word -3, graphic state change -2, shot cut -4..-6 (inside a pause >= 200 ms), counter starts at the number word
constraints.density: >= 20 events/min; no gap > 4 s without an event (hold <= 6 s with reason); shot median 6-12 s, max 25 s (shots > 12 s: an event every 3 s)
constraints.coverage: every sentence >= 1 anchored event; >= 80 % of sentences a mechanism event; every spoken number and every first-mention term on screen
constraints.kinetic: 8-20 kinetic words per minute; <= 6 words and <= 2 lines on screen; impact word 1-2 words
constraints.fx: hero (real-time 3D) <= 5 % of chapter frames (ADR-002 RT5); fx_tier lite|standard|hero
constraints.text: text on busy backgrounds needs a plate or halo; sizes and safe areas: 04 sections 3.2 and 3.4
banned: invented numbers (every number: data-contract id or source sentence)
constraints.components: use only frozen components (harness/schemas/components/); requests go to corpus/specs/_component_requests.jsonl
constraints.chapter_rhythm: problem -> mental model -> progressive visual -> worked example -> prediction -> failure (crit) -> fix (ok) -> callback -> artifact (per chapter, not per sentence)

storyboard_notes.text: CH-15..CH-20 zigzag and CH-17 before CH-23 (ADR-001): open and close with callbacks that re-establish where we are on the A-01 map and name the chapter we return to.

sentences.ar: الـwarehouse مش database واحدة، دي طبقات كل واحدة ليها شغلانة.
sentences.en: A warehouse is not one database, it is layers with different jobs.

sentences.ar: الـODS قاعد قريب من المصدر وبيحافظ على شكله.
sentences.en: The operational data store sits close to the source and keeps its shape.
The warehouse integrates sources and keeps history.

sentences.ar: والطبقة المنسَّقة أو الـADS بتخدم التحليل.
sentences.en: The application or curated layer serves analysis.

sentences.ar: والـmarts بتقرّب المجال من الناس اللي بتسأل عنه.
sentences.en: Marts bring a domain close to the people who ask about it.

sentences.ar: والفصل ده هو اللي بيخلّي الـdebugging والـownership ممكنين الـingestion مش storage، والـstorage مش الطبقة الدلالية، والعرض مش governance.
sentences.en: Separating those is what makes debugging and ownership possible — ingestion is not storage, storage is not the semantic layer, and presentation is not governance.

sentences.ar: وجوه الـwarehouse، الشكل اللي عاش تلاتين سنة: جدول حقائق في النص، وdimensions حواليه.
sentences.en: Inside the warehouse, the shape that has survived thirty years: a fact table in the middle, dimensions around it.

sentences.ar: الـfact بيشيل measures وforeign keys على grain معلَن واحد، والـgrain مكتوب على الجدول مش مفترَض. والـdimensions بتوصف.
sentences.en: The fact holds measures and foreign keys at one declared grain, and the grain is written on the table, not assumed. Dimensions describe.

sentences.ar: والـcube عبارة عن group-by تقدر تلف حواليه.
sentences.en: A cube is a group-by you can walk around.

sentences.ar: اعمل roll up من الشهر للربع والشبكة تتحول من تمنتاشر خلية لستة، وورا كل واحدة فيهم صفوف بتلات أضعاف.
sentences.en: Roll up from month to quarter and the grid goes from eighteen cells to six, with three times as many rows behind each one.

sentences.ar: دوس على خلية والنطاق يضيق من ميتين وستاشر صف لاتنين وسبعين.
sentences.en: Click a cell and the scope narrows from two hundred and sixteen rows to seventy-two.

sentences.ar: الـslice بتشيل مستوى؛ والـdice بتختار مكعب فرعي.
sentences.en: Slice removes a plane; dice selects a sub-cube.

sentences.ar: وتحذير بيكلّف شركات فلوس حقيقية: متوسط قيمة الطلب مش قابل للجمع.
sentences.en: And a warning that costs companies real money: average order value is not additive.

sentences.ar: ما ينفعش تاخد متوسط المتوسطات بتحسب الإجمالي على الإجمالي، لكل خلية، كل مرة.
sentences.en: You cannot average the averages — you compute total over total, per cell, every time.

sentences.ar: بعدها التاريخ. حقيقة في يوليو لازم تتوصل بفئة العميل في يوليو، مش فئته النهارده.
sentences.en: Then history. A July fact must join to July's customer tier, not today's.

sentences.ar: دي slowly changing dimension، ولو غلطت فيها بتكون بتعيد كتابة الماضي في الهدوء.
sentences.en: That is a slowly changing dimension, and getting it wrong rewrites the past silently.

sentences.ar: وأخيراً: لما KPI يطلع غلط، ما تعدّلش المعادلة.
sentences.en: Finally: when a KPI is wrong, do not edit the formula.

sentences.ar: اتتبّعه بالعكس dashboard، measure، mart، warehouse، transformation، ingestion، مصدر.
sentences.en: Trace it backwards — dashboard, measure, mart, warehouse, transformation, ingestion, source.

sentences.ar: والـlineage هو الفرق بين إنك تصلّح رقم وإنك تصلّح سبب.
sentences.en: The lineage graph is the difference between fixing a number and fixing a cause.

facts.rule: A number goes on screen with its fact id as `ref`/`data_refs`. `unmatched_numbers` are spoken but have no data-contract fact: their source is the sentence itself (a valid `s:` ref); never replace them with a different figure.

glossary.rule: Explain the term in Egyptian Arabic the first time it appears; then use the original term naturally, in Latin script, inside Arabic sentences.
glossary.register_ar: Natural Egyptian, clear, calm, professional. Use إحنا and خلّينا نشوف and ببساطة where they help. No heavy Modern Standard Arabic. No exaggerated slang. Numbers are spoken naturally in Egyptian but displayed as Western digits.
glossary.register_en: Plain, direct, unhurried. Short sentences. No hype, no "imagine that…", no rhetorical questions that are not real prediction prompts. Say the number, then pause for half a beat before the next sentence — the pause is where the viewer reads the screen.
glossary.never_translate_rule: Explain them in Egyptian Arabic the first time they appear, then use the original term naturally.

glossary.on_screen: Western digits, Latin terms in LTR isolates, Egyptian Arabic copy (no MSA), no per-letter animation (04 section 3.4).

concepts.def_en: An organized store of data managed by software that lets many users and programs safely r…
concepts.failure: Treating a database as a bigger spreadsheet, ignoring keys, constraints and concurrent wr…

concepts.def_en: Operational Data Store: a layer close to the source that keeps its shape, holding raw data for a short retention, used by ETL developers.
concepts.def_ar: Operational Data Store: طبقة قريبة من المصدر بتحافظ على شكله، فيها داتا خام لأيام قليلة، ومطوّرو الـETL هم اللي بيستخدموها.
concepts.failure: Using the ODS for long-term analytics instead of a short-retention raw layer.

concepts.def_en: The warehouse's top, application-facing layer: curated, analysis-ready tables that reports and dashboards read directly.
concepts.def_ar: الـADS أعلى طبقة في الـwarehouse: جداول جاهزة للتحليل، والـdashboards والتقارير بتقرا منها على طول.
concepts.failure: Querying raw ODS tables for dashboards instead of the curated ADS layer.

concepts.def_en: Finding the real cause of a bug by forming a hypothesis, testing it, and reading evidence…
concepts.failure: Changing code at random instead of testing a hypothesis about the cause.

concepts.def_en: The durable layer where data persists after programs stop, such as disks or a warehouse, separate from ingestion and presentation.
concepts.def_ar: الطبقة اللي الداتا بتفضل فيها بعد ما البرامج تقفل، زي الـdisk أو الـwarehouse، ومنفصلة عن الـingestion والعرض.
concepts.failure: Treating ingestion, storage and presentation as one step, so ownership and debugging get blurred.

concepts.def_en: A warehouse table at the center of a star schema, holding measurable events and numbers, each row linked to surrounding dimension tables.
concepts.def_ar: جدول في نص الـstar schema فيه الأحداث والأرقام القابلة للقياس، وكل صف مربوط بـdimension tables حواليه.
concepts.failure: Mixing different grains in one fact table, double-counting totals.

concepts.def_en: What exactly one row represents, such as one order line; every metric must be computed at…
concepts.failure: Computing a SUM at the wrong grain, getting a confident but wrong number.

concepts.def_en: SQL clause that splits rows into groups sharing the same key values, so aggregates like S…
concepts.failure: Grouping on a dirty key, so one customer splits into many groups.

concepts.def_en: Aggregating data to a coarser level of a dimension hierarchy, such as month to quarter, giving fewer, summarised cells.
concepts.def_ar: الـroll up إنك تلخّص الداتا لمستوى أعم في الـhierarchy، زي من شهر لربع سنة، فالخلايا بتقل.
concepts.failure: Rolling up a non-additive measure like an average by simply summing the detail rows.

concepts.def_en: A dimension whose attributes change over time; SCD Type 2 keeps history by closing the old row and opening a new one.
concepts.def_ar: الـSCD هو dimension بتتغير بياناته مع الوقت؛ في Type 2 بنقفل الصف القديم ونفتح صف جديد عشان التاريخ يتحفظ.
concepts.failure: Overwriting the old value (Type 1) silently rewrites past reports with today's attributes.

concepts.def_en: Key Performance Indicator: a business metric chosen to track progress toward a goal, defi…
concepts.failure: Redefining the same KPI slightly differently in several dashboards, so numbers disagree.

concepts.def_en: A single screen of charts and key numbers that lets people monitor metrics and make decis…
concepts.failure: Cramming many unrelated charts together, so viewers cannot see what to act on.

concepts.def_en: A calculation defined once and evaluated against whichever rows survive the current filte…
concepts.failure: Treating a measure like a stored column; it recalculates differently under each filter.

concepts.def_en: The traceable path of data from its source through every transformation to the final number, showing where a figure came from.
concepts.def_ar: مسار الداتا من المصدر لحد الرقم النهائي عبر كل تحويلة، بيبيّن الرقم ده جه منين.
concepts.failure: Patching the dashboard number instead of tracing lineage to fix the root cause.

components.does: One whole word (or a tatweel-joined compound like الـKafka) on screen; never split per letter.
Up to 6 kinetic words on at most 2 lines, each word arriving on its own spoken word anchor.
A technical term chip (Latin in an LTR isolate) with an optional Arabic gloss; 28 px floor if spoken.
A counter that rolls from the previous value to the target over the spoken number (preset count).
An arrow from a label to a target layer (or a named part of it, 'layer.part').
Failure beat: glitch + low thud; flashes stay <= 3/s (WCAG 2.3.1).
Fix beat: the target settles into place with a settle chime.
The shot camera: move + ease + intensity; drift always on; optional impact nudges (<= 4 px) on anchors.
Match cut between a layer of this shot and one of the next.
Lower-third caption for a source, term, speaker or location.
Draw an SVG path (stroke reveal; RTL by default for Arabic layouts).
Stacked layers (docker image, OSI, model, generic); cached layers glow.
A 3-axis cube supporting slice, dice, roll-up and drill-down.
Events on a track; the cursor moves on anchors.
A panel of 1-6 KPIs with status colours.
A payload travelling through 2-8 stations; a station can fail and be fixed.
Trunk chapter title card (riser + sting in the SFX map).
